svg.text: Workspaces with a billing problem, newest first. Ogen never changes a workspace’s tier or status on its own —
suspend, move the tier, or resync from here. Refunds and cancellations happen in Lemon Squeezy.
Renewal failed; Lemon Squeezy is retryin
One tier at a time can start with a free month: card in Lemon Squeezy, $0 today,
then the tier’s normal price. Changes apply to new checkouts only — people already
in their free month keep it — and public pricing pages pick them up within 5 minutes.
Each account gets one free month in total.
Invalidates every test-mode subscription, puts those workspaces back behind the
checkout gate and asks their owners to check out again with a real card. Follow
the cutover runbook ↗; step 4 is rotating the Lemon Squeezy keys in Secrets.
Type “invalidate test subscriptions” to run it for real
